components.name: brightnessctl
components.purpose: sysfs backlight control, which the two XF86 brightness keys drive through `scripts/iarch-brightness.sh`: a five percent step up in the prefix form and down in the suffix form, with a floor of one unit above off so that a key the compositor repeats while it is held cannot walk the backlight to a black screen.
components.notes: Repository, version and licence were read out of Arch's package search JSON API on 2026-11-09, and the flags were read against brightnessctl(1) and the source at tag 0.5.1: `--min-value` is declared an `optional_argument`, so its value has to be attached with `=` rather than passed as a separate word, and a non-root `set` falls back to logind's `Session.SetBrightness` only in a build with `ENABLE_SYSTEMD` -- which is the build Arch's own PKGBUILD makes for both build() and package(), so on this distribution the key needs neither root nor the `video` group nor a setuid binary. No machine in the development sandbox has a backlight, so no step was ever sent.
